studies.title: Djinguereber Mosque — c. 1900
studies.caption: About 1900. Timber beams project from the earthen walls of Timbuktu's mosque.
studies.prompt: Street-level angled study Djinguereber mosque Timbuktu, low mud plaster mass and tapered SQUARE minaret, projecting toron, sandy lane; NOT Djenne triple-tower facade, no giant gold dome.
